column1: # mapping_set_title: SWAT4HCLS BioHackathon 2025: HERO to GA4GH VRS

# mapping_set_description: Mappings declared during the SWAT4HCLS 2025 BioHackathon between the HERO genomics ontology and the GA4GH Variation Representation Specification. Transcribed from the project's curation spreadsheet; see mappings/README.md for the normalisations applied.

# comment: Object CURIEs in the source sheet alternated between ga4gh: and ga4ghvrs:; both are normalised to vrs1: here. The curators worked against GA4GH VRS 1.2/1.3, so objects use the vrs1: prefix (VRS 1.3). Several targets here -- Genotype, Haplotype, SequenceInterval, ChromosomeLocation, Text, Residue, Feature, Gene, UtilityVariation -- were removed in VRS 2.0, which is the version vcf-core itself targets. See mappings/vcf-core-alignments.sssom.tsv for the vcf-core to VRS 2.0 spoke. Transcription verified against the source sheet on 2026-09-08: subject, predicate and object of every row match after the normalisations noted above.
